purpose: Reader-facing discovery layer for non-Mundarica Munda/Mundari sources. These are source leads, not extracted cultural claims and not proof of redistribution/commercial rights.

records.title: WALS Online — Language Mundari
records.publisher: WALS Online
records.notes: Mundari language profile and bibliography including Hoffmann 1903, Cook 1965, Gumperz & Biligiri 1957, Osada 1992 and others.
records.rights_note: Follow source terms for reuse.

records.title: Mundari bibliography — ISFAS, Kiel University

records.title: Mundari language (Kherwari) — Online Books Page

records.title: The Changing Munda
records.publisher: Google Books

records.title: Some Munda Etymologies

records.title: Linguistic Survey of India — Jharkhand
records.publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
records.notes: Official Census India catalogue record published 2023-08-01. The volume includes a modern descriptive grammar study of Mundari in Jharkhand based on survey work in Ranchi district, covering phonology, morphophonemics, morphology and syntax.
records.rights_note: Official repository access verified; redistribution and derivative-use conditions must follow Census India terms.

records.title: The Present Study: Mundari Language — LSI Jharkhand
records.publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
records.notes: Official PDF section describing Mundari of Jharkhand; states survey location in Murhu village, Khunti area, and names informants Chamra Munda and Ramdi Mundu. Scope includes phonology, morphophonemics, morphology and syntax. Registered as a source lead only; extracted statements require page-level evidence records before public factual use.
records.rights_note: Public download does not automatically establish unrestricted redistribution or commercial reuse.

records.title: Grammatical Sketches of India Languages with Comparative Vocabulary and Texts, Part I — Census 1971
records.publisher: Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
records.notes: Official Census India catalogue record for a 1975, 563-page Language Monograph 1961 Series volume containing grammatical sketches, comparative vocabulary, texts, and script-character/phonemic-symbol material. Relevance to individual Munda/Mundari sections must be confirmed at page level before claim extraction.
records.rights_note: Rights field is Office of the Registrar General, India; reuse must follow source terms.

records.title: C-17: Population by bilingualism and trilingualism, Jharkhand — Census 2011
records.publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
records.notes: Official Census 2011 table catalogue includes MUNDA and MUNDARI language fields and subsidiary-language fields for Jharkhand. Suitable for demographic/language-vitality evidence after exact variable and table extraction.
records.rights_note: Dataset access is public through Census India; reuse and redistribution must follow source terms.

records.title: Mundari songs — historical sound recording

records.title: Durang Kahani: Alope Joma / Tuila accompaniment to the Mundari marriage song

The catalogue states that LSI recording documentation links recordings to transcriptions and English translations; those linked documents require separate source registration before evidence extraction.
